Usage: drive park <view> <reason> ... [flags]

Stop a session's wakes until a step is sent to it, keeping why.

A parked session sends no wakes until a step is sent to it, so a session
waiting on the owner, or on another session's hold, stops waking the driver.

Arguments:
  <view>              The view the park was decided on.
  <reason> ...        Why it waits, such as what only the owner can give; the record keeps it.

Inherited flags:
  -h, --help          Show context-sensitive help.
      --batch=NAME    Act in this batch instead of the current one, which stays current. It may
                      stand anywhere on the line.

Exit codes:
  0    success
  1    refused: nothing was done; next: says what to run instead
  2    invalid arguments; nothing was run
  3    tried and did not end as asked; the message says what did happen
  4    the session's login was rejected; next: relaunches it on another account, or says to tell the
       owner
